ammonia.reason: No aging or deamination of amino acids in fresh rennet curd, no NH3 accumulation.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized clean milk with no ripening, very low p-cresol, indole and skatole.

bitter.reason: No proteolysis to hydrophobic peptides, high pH and very short age prevents bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti and no lipolysis-derived 2-heptanone, 2-nonanone.

browning.reason: Maillard between lactose and lysine plus caramelization during 200-285C oven baking to 82C internal.

buttery.reason: Milkfat diacetyl and acetoin at milk background only, no starter citrate fermentation.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Minimal lipase activity in fresh curd, very low free butanoic and hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: 26% fat gives creamy mouthfeel but dense calcium-crosslinked rennet network resists cream flow.

crumbliness.reason: High pH intact casein with insoluble calcium retains elastic cohesive network, not short.

firmness.reason: Moisture 41-42% baked fresh gel with squeaky elastic protein matrix, not hard-aged.

floral_honey.reason: Only trace milk lactones and phenylacetaldehyde, no ripened phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: No esterase activity or ethanol fermentation, negligible ethyl butanoate/hexanoate formation.

goaty.reason: Bovine milk low in caproic, caprylic and branched 4-methyloctanoic goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: No Strecker aldehydes from aging, light pyrazines and maltol only from crust baking.

melt.reason: High pH 6.1-6.6 rennet plus baked protein denaturation prevents casein flow on reheating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No mold metabolism, no 1-octen-3-ol or 1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Intact fat globules trapped in fresh protein matrix, minimal free oil without proteolysis.

smoky.reason: Trace guaiacol and furans from oven char spots, not wood-smoked, mild toasted note.

sour_vinegar.reason: No starter culture, whey drainage at pH 6.55 and final pH 6.11, very low lactic/acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Rennet gel without pasta-filata hot-water alignment, calcium-bound casein squeaks not strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Brief high-heat bake denatures beta-lactoglobulin releasing trace H2S and dimethyl sulfide.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose retained due to no fermentation plus caramelized lactose perceived as sweet.

umami.reason: Intact casein with very low proteolysis, little free glutamate or 5-nucleotides released.
